parts.name: Upper Door
parts.Basic_description: This is the upper door of the microwave, made of tempered glass and stainless steel, forming the front access panel for the cooking chamber.
parts.Functional_description: It allows access to the microwave cavity for placing or removing food and provides a viewing window during operation.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates about a side hinge to open and close.

parts.name: Side Controls
parts.Basic_description: This part contains the control panel of the microwave, typically made of durable plastic with embedded buttons or a touch interface.
parts.Functional_description: It is used to set cooking time, power level, and other functions of the microwave.
parts.Movement_description: It remains fixed; only the buttons or touch sensors are activated by user input.

parts.name: Frame
parts.Basic_description: This is the main structural frame of the microwave, made of stainless steel, providing rigidity and housing for internal components.
parts.Functional_description: It supports all other parts, including the magnetron, door, and control panel, ensuring structural integrity and safety.
parts.Movement_description: It is a fixed, non-moving component.

parts.name: Lower Door
parts.Basic_description: This is the lower door of the microwave, made of tempered glass and stainless steel, similar to the upper door.
parts.Functional_description: It provides access to the lower cooking compartment and allows visibility during operation.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates about a side hinge to open and close.
